reason: The README documents seven model-facing tools for creating, reading, and updating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files within a session workspace, so document processing is the primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供在会话工作区内创建、读取和更新 Word、Excel 与 PowerPoint 文件的工具。
summaries.en: Provides agent-facing tools to create, read, and update Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files within the session workspace.

capabilities: Create, read, and update DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files
Read and write files within the calling agent's session workspace
Embed PNG, JPG, and GIF images in PowerPoint files
Parse document text, spreadsheet cells, slide text, notes, and image counts
